decision: Choose eu-west-1, because accepted ADR 0007 (decision-log) requires customer data to be in EU regions only and the jobs carry the customer list. Mira's no-customer-names-in-logs rule applies to all her repos and products, so I drafted it as a new ADR in the decision log.

recorded.info: New ADR 0024 (Accepted, left uncommitted for Mira to confirm and merge): no product or repo may ever write a customer's name into a log (decision key log-no-customer-names).
